Mountains have been a constant presence in the Middle Eastern landscape and culture. They are considered as a source of inspiration and have symbolized power, stability, and resilience throughout history. Places like Mount Sinai and Mount Hira hold immense significance in Islamic history, where Prophet Moses received the Ten Commandments and Prophet Muhammad received his initial revelations from Allah (SWT). Hence, the name Araa reflects those strong and symbolic associations with mountains, bringing out feelings of strength, resilience, and connection to the rich cultural heritage of the Muslim world.
